upload_batch_input_file: upload a JSONL file to the LiteLLM proxy for batch processing with a target Bedrock model
create_batch_job: create a batch job on the LiteLLM proxy using an uploaded input file with a 24-hour completion window
configure_openai_client_for_proxy: configure an OpenAI client to point at a local LiteLLM proxy server on port 4000
set_bedrock_batch_model: set the Bedrock batch model name to target Claude 3.5 Sonnet via the LiteLLM proxy
run_bedrock_batch_completions: run batch completions against a Bedrock model through the LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI batch API
